title: P99M worth of contraband seized in Naval Command maritime operations

blocks.text: ZAMBOANGA CITY- Nearly P100 million worth of contraband were seized in three separate operations by the Naval Command Western Mindanao in three separate operations in the region from August 28 to September 3 in the region. The biggest seizure involved P72.17 million worth of undocumented diesel. The Command also seized P27.23 million worth of smuggled foreign cigarettes and the motor vessel used to transport the items, and illegally transported lauan lumber worth P251,999.50. The contraband seized amounted to P99,653, 015 in total. Rear Admiral Constancio Arturo M. Reyes Jr, Naval Command Western Mindanao Commander, commended the operating units and partner agencies for their coordination and vigilance which led to the successful conduct of operations. “These operations reflect NCWM’s sustained commitment to securing the maritime domain of Western Mindanao and preventing its use for smuggling and other illegal activities,” Reyes said.
